abilities.name: Ineluctable
abilities.desc:
When any ally target's attack inflicts a debuff on an enemy, Welt will additionally deal Imaginary Additional DMG equal to 150%/187%/750% of his ATK and apply 1 stack(s) of "Ineluctable."
"Ineluctable": Each stack reduces SPD by 4%/5%/6%, increases DMG taken by 4%/6%/8%, and increases DMG taken from Welt by an additional 4%/6%/8%, stacking up to 5 times.

abilities.name: Edge of the Void
abilities.desc: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to 240%/300%/1,200% of Welt's ATK to one designated enemy and deals 4 additional instances of DMG. For each enemy afflicted with "Ineluctable," additionally deals 1 instance of DMG. Each damage instance deals Imaginary DMG equal to 240%/300%/1,200% of Welt's ATK to a random enemy. On hit, there is a 75% base chance to reduce the hit enemy target's SPD by 10% for 2 turn(s).

abilities.name: Synthetic Black Hole
abilities.desc:
Deals Imaginary DMG equal to 500%/625%/2,500% of Welt's ATK to all enemies, inflicting 3 stack(s) of "Ineluctable" to all enemies and delaying the combat end countdown by 20/20/100 action value. This delay is capped at 100/100/999 action value per battle. There is a 100% base chance to inflict Imprisonment on the attacked enemy target for 1 turn.
While Imprisoned, the enemy target's action is delayed by 40% and their SPD is reduced by 10%.
After using Ultimate, inflicts "Weightless" on all enemies. When targets in "Weightless" state are attacked, their actions are delayed by 4.0%. This effect can trigger up to 8 time(s) per target per turn. "Weightless" state lasts for 2 turn(s).

abilities.name: Caladbolg II: Fake Spiral Sword
abilities.desc: Enters the "Circuit Connection" state. Deals Quantum DMG equal to 360%/450%/1,800% of Archer's ATK to one designated enemy. After using Skill in the "Circuit Connection" state, the current turn does not end, and Archer's DMG dealt by Skill increases by 100%. This effect can stack up to 2 time(s), lasting until he exits the "Circuit Connection" state. After actively using Skill 5/5/10 time(s) or when Skill Points are insufficient to use Skill again, exits the "Circuit Connection" state. After all enemy targets have been defeated in a wave, exits the "Circuit Connection" state. When actively using Skill for the 5/5/10 time, consumes all remaining ally Skill Points, with each consumed Skill Point additionally increasing this instance of Skill's multiplier by 240%/300%/480%.

abilities.name: Unlimited Blade Works
abilities.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to 1,000%/1,250%/5,000% of Archer's ATK to one designated enemy, and Quantum DMG equal to 500%/625%/2,500% of Archer's ATK to other enemy targets. Gains 2 point(s) of Charge, up to a maximum of 4.

units.name: Topaz & Numby

abilities.name: Difficulty Paying?
abilities.desc:
Use during action. Topaz and Numby act at 200%/250%/300% SPD.
Numby deals Fire DMG equal to Topaz's 1,100%/1,375%/5,500% ATK to all enemies. When Numby deals DMG with this Skill, it is considered as a Follow-Up ATK. For each target hit, there is a 30%/50%/100% chance to obtain 1/1/5 Gold Coins. You can obtain up to 3/5/99 Gold Coin(s) in this way per combat.

abilities.name: Snowball Effect
abilities.desc: After an ally (other than Topaz & Numby) attacks, Topaz and Numby's actions advance by 8%/8%/50%. If the attack is a Follow-Up ATK, Topaz and Numby's actions advance by 12%/12%/50%. When enemy targets enter combat, they will be inflicted with "Proof of Debt: Modified", increasing all DMG taken by 50%.

eidolons.name: Future Market
eidolons.desc:
When enemies afflicted with "Proof of Debt" receive attacks, they will enter the "Debtor" state. This can take effect only once within a single attack.
 The "Debtor" state increases the CRIT DMG inflicted on the target enemies by 25%, stacking up to 2 time(s). When "Proof of Debt" is removed, the "Debtor" state is also removed.

eidolons.name: Bona Fide Acquisition
eidolons.desc: Topaz & Numby's SPD increases by 20%.

eidolons.name: Seize the Big and Free the Small
eidolons.desc: Topaz & Numby's Independent DMG Amplification increases by 8%.

eidolons.name: Agile Operation
eidolons.desc: After Numby takes action, the next action advances by 20%.

eidolons.name: Inflationary Demand
eidolons.desc: Topaz & Numby's Independent DMG Amplification increases by 8%.

eidolons.name: Incentive Mechanism
eidolons.desc: DMG dealt by "Difficulty Paying?" will be 120% of the original DMG. Topaz & Numby's All-Type RES PEN increases by 20%.

lightCone.name: Worrisome, Blissful
lightCone.desc: Increases Topaz & Numby's Independent DMG Amplification by 12%/18%/24%/30%/36%

units.image: Character Topaz and Numby Currency Wars.png

abilities.name: Prana Extirpated
abilities.desc:
Summons "Lightning-Lord" at the start of battle. "Lightning-Lord" initially has 300/300/500 SPD and 5 Hits Per Action. When taking action, launches Follow-Up ATKs, with each hit dealing Lightning DMG equal to 200%/250%/1,000% of Jing Yuan's ATK to one random enemy, and deal Lightning DMG equal to 50% of the DMG dealt to the primary target to adjacent targets.
Increases "Lightning-Lord"'s SPD boosts by 50 for each Hits Per Action. "Lightning-Lord" immediately takes action after accumulating 15 Hits Per Action. After the action ends, its SPD and Hits Per Action return to their initial values.
When Jing Yuan is knocked down, "Lightning-Lord" will disappear.
When Jing Yuan is unable to take action, "Lightning-Lord" is also unable to take action.

abilities.name: Divine Resonance
abilities.desc: Jing Yuan is immune to Crowd Control debuffs. After using his Skill / Ultimate, additionally increases "Lightning-Lord's" Hits Per Action in the next turn by 2/2/20 / 3/3/20. After Lightning-Lord takes action, advances Jing Yuan's action by 50%/50%/80% and recovers 1 Skill Point(s).

units.name: Yunli

abilities.name: Earthbind, Etherbreak
abilities.desc:
Use at full Energy. After an on-field ally / other off-field ally targets / an enemy target launches an attack, regenerates 12/12/20 Energy for Yunli.
Immediately activates "Intuit: Cull" and gains 2 stack(s) of "Sword and Shield," stacking up to 3 time(s).
"Intuit: Cull": Deals Physical DMG equal to 480%/600%/2,400% of Yunli's ATK to the target and Physical DMG equal to 240%/300%/1,200% of Yunli's ATK to adjacent targets, then deals 6 additional instances of DMG, each dealing Physical DMG equal to 200%/250%/1,000% of Yunli's ATK to one random enemy.
This is a Counter ability. DMG dealt by Yunli with this ability is considered Ultimate DMG.

abilities.name: Flicker
abilities.desc:
When on-field ally characters receive attacks from enemy targets and if Yunli has "Sword and Shield" stacks, immediately consumes 1 stack to make the first target among the targets hit immune to damage. Then, immediately launches the Counter "Intuit: Slash" at the attacker. Yunli's ATK increases by 30%/40%/50% and CRIT DMG by 100%/120%/140%.
"Intuit: Slash": Deals Physical DMG equal to 320%/400%/1,600% of Yunli's ATK to the target, and Physical DMG equal to 160%/200%/800% of Yunli's ATK to adjacent targets. If there is no target to Counter, then Counters a random enemy target instead.

eidolons.name: Weathered Blade Does Not Sully
eidolons.desc: Increases Yunli's DMG dealt by 20%. Increases the number of additional DMG instances for "Intuit: Cull" by 3.

eidolons.name: First Luster Breaks Dawn
eidolons.desc: When dealing DMG via Counter, ignores 20% of the target's DEF.

eidolons.name: Mastlength Twirls Mountweight
eidolons.desc: Increases Yunli's Independent DMG Amplification by 8%.

eidolons.name: Artisan's Ironsong
eidolons.desc: Increases the ally squad's Effect RES by 25%.

eidolons.name: Blade of Old Outlasts All
eidolons.desc: Increases Yunli's Independent DMG Amplification by 8%.

eidolons.name: Walk in Blade, Talk in Zither
eidolons.desc: Increases Yunli's CRIT Rate by 15% and All-Type RES PEN by 20%. After on-field allies/other off-field allies/enemy targets attack, Yunli additionally regenerates 3/3/10 Energy.

lightCone.name: Dance at Sunset
lightCone.desc: Increases Yunli's Independent DMG Amplification by 12%/18%/24%/30%/36%.

notes: Yunli starts with 120 Energy and 1 stack of "Sword and Shield."

abilities.name: Decadence, False Twilight
abilities.desc:
Use during action. Black Swan acts at 200%/250%/300% SPD.
Deals Wind DMG equal to 300%/375%/1,500% of Black Swan's ATK to one designated enemy and adjacent targets. At the same time, there is a 100% base chance of reducing the DEF of the target and the adjacent targets by 20.0%/30.0%/40.0%, lasting for 3 turn(s).

abilities.name: Bliss of Otherworld's Embrace
abilities.desc:
Use when Energy is full.
Skill regenerates 30 Energy. Additionally, when "Arcana" deals DMG at the start of an enemy target's turn, Black Swan regenerates 0.5 Energy for each "Arcana" stack.
Inflicts "Epiphany" state on all enemy targets for 2 turn(s). Then deals Wind DMG to all enemy targets equal to 500%/625%/2,500% of Black Swan's ATK.
While in the "Epiphany" state, enemy targets take 25%/35%/50% increased DMG. For every 1 stack of "Arcana" inflicted, there is a 100% fixed chance to additionally increase the number of "Arcana" stacked this time by 1. And "Arcana" stacks won't be halved after dealing DMG at the start of the turn.

abilities.name: Loom of Fate's Caprice
abilities.desc:
When enemy targets enter combat or receive 1 instance of DoT, they have a 65% base chance to be inflicted with 1 stacks of "Arcana." After the ally squad launches an attack, there is a 65% base chance to apply 1 stacks of "Arcana" to the target.
While afflicted with "Arcana," enemy targets are considered as also being Wind Sheared, Bleeding, Burned, and Shocked. At the start of each turn, they receive Wind DoT equal to 300%/375%/1,500% of Black Swan's ATK, after which the stacks are halved. Each stack of "Arcana" increases this DMG's multiplier by 20.0%/25.0%/100.0%. "Arcana" can stack up to 50 times. Stacks can exceed the limit, but excess stacks are removed after DMG is dealt.
DMG dealt by "Arcana" ignores 20% of the target's DEF. Only when "Arcana" deals DMG at the start of an enemy target's turn, adjacent targets receive 1 extra instance of Wind DoT equal to 300%/375%/1,500% of Black Swan's ATK.
Ally squad DMG dealt increases by 72%/90%/120%.

eidolons.name: Seven Pillars of Wisdom
eidolons.desc: Enemy targets afflicted with Wind Shear, Bleed, Burn, or Shock will have their corresponding Wind, Physical, Fire, or Lightning RES respectively reduced by 25%.

eidolons.name: Weep Not For Me, My Lamb
eidolons.desc: When enemy targets enter combat, there is a 100% base chance to inflict 30 stack(s) of "Arcana" on them.

eidolons.name: As Above, So Below
eidolons.desc: Increases Black Swan's Independent DMG Amplification by 5%, and increases the ally squad's Independent DMG Amplification by 2%.

eidolons.name: In Tears We Gift
eidolons.desc: While in the "Epiphany" state, enemy targets take 10% increased DMG. And at the start of every turn or when they get defeated, regenerates 8 Energy for Black Swan.

eidolons.name: Linnutee Flyway
eidolons.desc: Increases Black Swan's Independent DMG Amplification by 5%, and increases the ally squad's Independent DMG Amplification by 2%.

eidolons.name: Pantheon Merciful, Masses Pitiful
eidolons.desc: Increases the max stackable count of "Arcana" by 30. When Character Empowerment is active, attacks from the ally squad increase the number of stacks of "Arcana" inflicted on the target by 1.

lightCone.name: Reforged Remembrance
lightCone.desc: Increases Black Swan's Independent DMG Amplification by 12%/18%/24%/30%/36%

units.name: Firefly

abilities.name: Supernova Overload
abilities.desc: Applies Fire Weakness to all enemies for 2 turns. Restores HP equal to 50% of this unit's Max HP, deals Fire DMG equal to (0.4 × Break Effect + 400.0%) of SAM's ATK to all enemies, reduces the enemy targets' All-Type RES by 30%/40%/50% for 2 turn(s), and additionally converts this attack's Toughness Reduction into a 100%/120%/500% Super Break DMG after the attack.

abilities.name: Complete Combustion
abilities.desc:
While in the "Complete Combustion" state, increases Super Break DMG multiplier dealt by "Module β: Autoreactive Armor" Trace by an additional 50%/100%/250%, and Super Break DMG can be triggered when attacking enemy targets who are not Weakness Broken.
Basic ATK and Skills additionally regenerate a fixed 40/40/120/60/60/120 Energy. Ultimate is replaced with "Supernova Overload."

notes: Upon entering combat, Firefly enters the Complete Combustion state regardless of Crowd Control debuff and advances her action by 100%. She maintains this state with no countdown for the rest of combat.
Supernova Overload deals 30 Toughness Reduction.

units.name: Cyrene

abilities.name: Epic of Chrysos
abilities.desc:
Chrysos Heir characters in the ally squad gain 1/2/99 stack(s) of "Epic of Chrysos," increasing their Character Empowerment effect based on the stacks of "Epic of Chrysos" gained.
Cyrene gains 9/9/27 "Recollection" point(s) at the start of combat. When she uses her Ultimate for the first time in a battle, she activates all off-field allies' Ultimates.
While Cyrene is on the field, the DMG Boost effect provided by her Talent also applies to all off-field allies.

abilities.name: Bloom, Elysium of Beyond
abilities.desc: Gains 3 "Recollection" and deploys a Zone that lasts 2 turns, with its duration decreasing by 1 at each start of Cyrene's turn. While the Zone is active, for each instance of DMG dealt by the ally squad, deals 1 additional instance of True DMG equal to 24%/30%/36% of the original DMG.

notes: Chrysos Heir characters affected by "Epic of Chrysos" include:

Prior to Version 4.3, there was a bug that if the player purchased a Poem with the Beloved One Bond not activated (due to Cyrene being removed from the team before purchasing), it wouldn't count towards the 1 purchase limit per Node, and the player could put her on the field again to refresh Poems.

abilities.name: Combat Redeployment
abilities.desc:
Dispels a debuff from one designated ally, causing them to immediately take action and deal 66% increased DMG for 1 turn(s). Increases the target and this unit's On-Field Strength by 60%/75%/100% and Lucky Strike Rate by 20%/25%/35% for 2 turn(s).
When using this ability on this unit, the immediate taking action effect cannot be triggered.

abilities.name: The Belobog March
abilities.desc: Applies "Assembly March" to this unit for 2 turn(s). While Bronya has this effect, increases ally squad's ATK by 55%, and CRIT DMG by 16.0% of Bronya's CRIT DMG plus 20.0%.

units.name: Silver Wolf LV.999

abilities.name: Hacker's Mirth
abilities.desc:
While Silver Wolf LV.999 uses her Elation Skill, she gains a 100% increase to Aha's on/off-field Strength, DMG Amplification, Lucky Strike Rate, Lucky Strike DMG, Break Efficiency, and Break Effect.
While Silver Wolf LV.999 uses her Basic ATK, she gains a 60%/70%/80% increase to Aha's on/off-field Strength, DMG Amplification, Lucky Strike Rate, Lucky Strike DMG, Break Efficiency, and Break Effect.

abilities.name: Hidden Stage
abilities.desc:
After reaching 180 "Hidden MMR" points during Transformation, Silver Wolf's DMG Amplification increases by 40%.
Gains 20/40/60 "Hidden MMR" point(s) upon entering combat.

notes: Upon the cost of Silver Wolf LV. 999 is tweaked:
For any remaining Silver Wolf LV. 999 in preperation area, they are sold immediately, returning equivalent Gold Coins.
For any remaining Silver Wolf LV. 999 in the shop, they are turned into the corresponding cost.
units.image: Character Silver Wolf LV.999 Currency Wars.png

abilities.name: Winter's Counterstrike
abilities.desc: At the start of each wave or when a Boss Enemy changes phase, provides all on-field ally targets with a Shield equal to 40%/60%/80% of Gepard's DEF plus 200/300/400 for 3 turn(s). When enemy targets attack, Gepard gains 1 Charge point. Upon reaching 4 charge points, immediately consumes 4 Charge points to launch a counter-attack, dealing damage to all enemy targets equal to 600%/960%/1,800% of Gepard's DEF plus 200%/250%/300% of the total Shield Effect on the ally squad.

abilities.name: Proud Stance
abilities.desc: When an ally target's Shield Effect exceeds their Max HP, their ATK increases by 40%/80%/120%.

units.name: Luocha

abilities.name: Prayer of Abyss Flower
abilities.desc:
Use during action. Luocha acts at 200%/250%/300% SPD.
Heals the on-field ally with the lowest current HP percentage for an amount equal to 64%/96%/128% of Luocha's ATK plus 400/600/800 and dispels 1 debuff(s). Meanwhile, Luocha gains 1 stack of "First Aid" (max 4 stacks).
When any on-field ally's current HP percentage falls to 50% or below, Luocha immediately consumes 1 stack of "First Aid" to trigger 1 instance of the healing and debuff dispelling effects equivalent to his Skill on this target.

abilities.name: Cycle of Life
abilities.desc:
Deploys a Zone at the start of combat that increases the ally squad's DMG dealt by 30%/60%/120%.
When any enemy target in the Zone is attacked by an on-field ally, the attacking on-field ally immediately restores HP by an amount equal to 32.0%/48.0%/64.0% of Luocha's ATK plus 400/600/800. Meanwhile, restores HP equal to 16%/24%/32% of Luocha's ATK plus 200/300/400 for other on-field allies.

eidolons.name: Ablution of the Quick
eidolons.desc: While the Zone is active, ATK of the ally squad increases by 20%.

eidolons.name: Bestowal From the Pure
eidolons.desc: When his Skill is triggered, if the target ally's HP percentage is lower than 50%, Luocha's Outgoing Healing increases by 30%. If the target ally's HP percentage is at 50% or higher, the ally receives a Shield that can absorb DMG equal to 18% of Luocha's ATK plus 240, lasting for 2 turns.

eidolons.name: Surveyal by the Fool
eidolons.desc: Increases the ally squad's Independent DMG Amplification by 3%.

eidolons.name: Heavy Lies the Crown
eidolons.desc: When Luocha's Zone is active, enemies become Weakened and deal 12% less DMG.

eidolons.name: Cicatrix 'Neath the Pain
eidolons.desc: Increases the ally squad's Independent DMG Amplification by 3%.

eidolons.name: Reunion With the Dust
eidolons.desc: Ally squad's All-Type RES PEN increases by 20%.

lightCone.name: Echoes of the Coffin
lightCone.desc: Increases ally squad's Independent DMG Amplification by 6%/9%/12%/15%/18%.

notes: Luocha starts with 1 stack of "First Aid."

units.name: Fu Xuan

abilities.name: Universal Matrix of Prescience
abilities.desc: Activates "Great Matrix of Prescience" at the start of combat, reducing DMG taken by on-field characters by 10%/15%/20% and distributing it among all on-field characters. Increases the ally squad's Lucky Strike DMG (18%/24%/30%+6%/8%/10%×QuantumSynchronized Frequency).

abilities.name: Inevitable Cycle of Reversal
abilities.desc: For every 5/3/1 enemy targets defeated or when a Boss Enemy changes phase, Fu Xuan gains 1 "Flip." While having "Flip," ally characters will not receive fatal damage. Maximum "Flip" stacks is 3. When an on-field character's HP drops below 30% of their Max HP, Fu Xuan consumes 1 "Flip" to restore HP equal to 60%/80%/100% of the respective HP lost for all on-field characters.

eidolons.name: Dominus Pacis
eidolons.desc: Ally squad's CRIT DMG increases by 30%.

eidolons.name: Optimus Felix
eidolons.desc: Gains 1 "Flip" at the start of battle.

eidolons.name: Apex Nexus
eidolons.desc: Increases the ally squad's Independent DMG Amplification by 3%.

eidolons.name: Fortuna Stellaris
eidolons.desc: Every time an enemy target accumulates 8 attacks, gains 1 stack(s) of "Flip."

eidolons.name: Arbiter Primus
eidolons.desc: Increases the ally squad's Independent DMG Amplification by 3%.

eidolons.name: Omnia Vita
eidolons.desc: When "Great Matrix of Prescience" is activated, the ally squad's DMG dealt increases by 50%.

lightCone.name: She Already Shut Her Eyes
lightCone.desc: Increases ally squad's Independent DMG Amplification by 6%/9%/12%/15%/18%.

notes: 1/2/3-Star Fu Xuan starts with 1/2/3 stack(s) of "Flip."

abilities.name: Darting Ironthorn
abilities.desc:
Use during action. Yanqing acts at 200%/250%/300% Speed.
Deals Ice DMG equal to 600%/750%/1,080% of Yanqing's ATK to one enemy target. There is a 120% base chance to Freeze the enemy target for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Cascading Laceration
abilities.desc:
Use at full Energy. Skill regenerates 30 Energy. Yanqing regenerates 15 Energy if another ally in the ally squad inflicts a debuff on the enemy target in an action.
Deals Ice DMG equal to 1,600%/2,000%/2,880% of Yanqing's ATK to all enemies.

abilities.name: Bladecore Enlightenment
abilities.desc: Yanqing obtains "Soulsteel Sync," increasing his CRIT Rate by 80% and CRIT DMG by 80%/100%/120%.

eidolons.name: Svelte Saber
eidolons.desc: When Yanqing attacks a Frozen enemy, he deals Ice Additional DMG equal to 120% of his ATK.

eidolons.name: Supine Serenade
eidolons.desc: Yanqing's Energy Regeneration Rate increases by 10%.

eidolons.name: Sword Savant
eidolons.desc: Yanqing's Independent DMG Amplification increases by 6%.

eidolons.name: Searing Sting
eidolons.desc: Yanqing's All-Type RES PEN increases by 12%.

eidolons.name: Surging Strife
eidolons.desc: Yanqing's Independent DMG Amplification increases by 6%.

eidolons.name: Swift Swoop
eidolons.desc: "Soulsteel Sync" CRIT Rate increases by 10% and CRIT DMG by 40%.

lightCone.name: Sleep Like the Dead
lightCone.desc: Increases Yanqing's Independent DMG Amplification by 6%/9%/12%/15%/18%.

abilities.name: Pinion's Aria
abilities.desc:
Use at the start of combat.
Increases DMG dealt by the ally squad by 30%/45%/60% until the end of combat. Bond members receive double the increase.

abilities.name: Vox Harmonique, Opus Cosmique
abilities.desc:
Use during action. Robin acts at 100%/125%/150% Speed.
Robin enters the "Concerto" state and makes all on-field ally targets immediately take action.
While in the "Concerto" state, increases ally squad's ATK by 16.0%/20.0%/26.0% of Robin's ATK plus 150/200/250, with bonded members receiving double the increase. After each attack by the ally squad, Robin additionally deals 2 instances of Physical Additional DMG equal to 120%/150%/216% of her ATK. This DMG is considered as Follow-Up ATK DMG, with a fixed CRIT Rate of 100% and fixed CRIT DMG of 150%/200%/250%.
A "Concerto" countdown appears in the Action Order. When the countdown's turn begins, Robin exits the "Concerto" state. The countdown has its own fixed SPD of 200.

eidolons.name: Land of Smiles
eidolons.desc: While the "Concerto" state is active, increases the ally squad's All-Type RES PEN by 24%.

eidolons.name: Afternoon Tea For Two
eidolons.desc: Increases Robin's SPD by 20%. While in "Concerto" state, increases the ally squad's SPD by 16%.

eidolons.name: Inverted Tuning
eidolons.desc: Increases Robin's Independent DMG Amplification by 5%, and increases the ally squad's Independent DMG Amplification by 2%.

eidolons.name: Raindrop Key
eidolons.desc: When using the Ultimate, dispels Crowd Control debuffs from the ally squad. While Robin is in the "Concerto" state, increases the Effect RES of all allies by 50%.

eidolons.name: Lonestar's Lament
eidolons.desc: Increases Robin's Independent DMG Amplification by 5%, and increases the ally squad's Independent DMG Amplification by 2%.

eidolons.name: Moonless Midnight
eidolons.desc: While the "Concerto" state is active, increases the CRIT DMG for the Physical Additional DMG caused by the Ultimate by 450%. The effect of "Moonless Midnight" can trigger up to 8 time(s) and the trigger count resets each time the Ultimate is used.

lightCone.name: Flowing Nightglow
lightCone.desc: Increases Robin's Independent DMG Amplification by 4%/6%/8%/10%/12%. Increases ally squad's Independent DMG Amplification by 4%/6%/8%/10%/12%.

abilities.name: Fanning the Hammer
abilities.desc:
Inflicts Physical Weakness on one designated enemy target, lasting for 2 turn(s). Deals Physical DMG equal to 220% of Boothill's ATK to one enemy and deals 2/3/5 additional instance(s) of DMG. Each additional instance deals Physical DMG equal to 60%/75%/100% of the original DMG multiplier and reduces Toughness equal to 60%/75%/100% of the original Toughness Reduction to one random enemy, prioritizing bouncing to enemy targets that haven't been hit by this attack.
Enhanced Basic ATK cannot recover Skill Points and can only target the enemy target in "Standoff" as the primary target.

abilities.name: Head Start
abilities.desc: Start combat with 1 stack(s) of "Pocket Trickshot." When using Ultimate, additionally reduces the target's Toughness by 20/40/60.

abilities.name: Five Peas in a Pod
abilities.desc:
Each stack of "Pocket Trickshot" increases the Enhanced Basic ATK's Toughness Reduction by 50%, stacking up to 3 time(s).
If the target in "Standoff" is Weakness Broken while the Enhanced Basic ATK is being used, based on the number of "Pocket Trickshot" stacks, deals Break DMG equal to 70%/120%/170% of Boothill's Physical Break DMG to all Weakness Broken targets. The max Toughness taken into account for this DMG cannot exceed 16 times the base Toughness Reduction of the Basic ATK "Skullcrush Spurs."

abilities.name: Puppet Warfare
abilities.desc: After the Herta uses Enhanced Skill, triggers a Follow-Up ATK performed by 1/2/5 "Herta Puppet(s)." Each "Herta puppet" participating in the Follow-Up ATK deals Ice DMG equal to 50%/60%/100% of The Herta's ATK, repeating 2 time(s). If Herta is present in the ally squad, each star in her rating increases the number of repetitions by 1.

abilities.name: Desolation Across Palms
abilities.desc:
For each point of HP lost by all allies, Castorice gains 1 "Newbud." When "Newbud" reaches its maximum, Ultimate can be activated. When allies lose HP, damage dealt by Castorice and Netherwing increases by 20%/30%/40%, stacking up to 3 time(s) and lasts for 3 turn(s). "Newbud" cap is fixed at 150,000. When Netherwing defeats an enemy target, it restores 15,000 HP, and 50% of its overflow HP will be recorded and converted to an equal amount of "Newbud" for Castorice after Netherwing disappears. When the number of ally squad characters in the team is less than 4/5/6/7, Castorice gains 200%/120%/70%/30% additional "Newbud."
While Netherwing is on the field, "Newbud" cannot be gained through Talent. For each point of HP lost by all allies except Netherwing, Netherwing will restore an equal amount of HP.

abilities.name: Boneclaw, Doomdrake's Embrace
abilities.desc:
Consumes 50% of the current HP of all allies (except Netherwing). Castorice and Netherwing launch Joint ATK, dealing Quantum DMG equal to 40.0%/60.0%/120.0% of Castorice's Max HP plus 60.0%/90.0%/180.0% of Castorice's Max HP to all enemies.
If the current HP is insufficient, reduces the current HP down to 1.

units.name: Hysilens

abilities.name: Song of the Sea
abilities.desc:
After Hysilens attacks, inflict 1 stack(s) of "Deep Sea Resonance" to the target.

strategies.image: Investment Strategy Role Model: Silver Icon.png

strategies.name: Sucker Punch
strategies.effect: At the start of each battle wave, deals 1000% base DMG to the enemy target with the highest Max HP and inflicts "Fragility" on the target, increasing their DMG taken by 30%.

strategies.name: Easy Mode
strategies.effect: Reduces the difficulty of enemies by 3, down to a minimum of 0.

strategies.name: Difficulty Modifier
strategies.effect: Reduces the difficulty of enemies in Encounter and Boss Nodes by 4, down to a minimum of 0.

strategies.name: I Want It ALL: Silver
strategies.effect: In this run, you have 2 fewer option(s) during the Supply phase. After making your selection in the next 1 Supply phase(s), you'll additionally receive all unselected characters and equipment.
strategies.image: Investment Strategy I Want It ALL: Silver Icon.png

strategies.name: Diamonds Always Shine
strategies.effect: After 2 Node(s), obtains "Red Gem" or "Blue Gem."
strategies.image: Investment Strategy Diamonds Always Shine Icon.png

strategies.name: Lucky Spray
strategies.effect: Increases the ally squad's Lucky Strike DMG by 25%.

strategies.name: The Joy of Growth
strategies.effect: After reaching Level 8, the Gold Coins required to purchase Experience is reduced by 1. Immediately grants 4 Experience.
strategies.image: Investment Strategy The Joy of Growth Icon.png

strategies.name: Diode
strategies.effect: In this match, your Encounter Nodes will only consist of the lowest and highest difficulties. Obtain 10 Squad HP and Max HP, and obtain 6 Gold Coins.

strategies.name: Complimentary Upgrade
strategies.effect: In this match, your Encounter Rewards are increased by 1 level(s) (Encounter 4 will also grant bonus rewards). Immediately obtain 4 Gold Coins.

strategies.name: Harmless Trash
strategies.effect: Gains a "Trash Bag" and 8 Gold Coins.

strategies.name: "Get Out of Battle Free" Card
strategies.effect: When entering a Combat Node, immediately skip the battle and enter the next Node. Can take effect 2 time(s). Obtaining this item grants 30 Experience.
strategies.image: Investment Strategy "Get Out of Battle Free" Card Icon.png

strategies.name: Experience Is Wealth
strategies.effect: When obtaining Experience, obtain an equal amount of Gold Coins instead (except when purchasing Experience). Obtain 4 Gold Coins.
strategies.image: Investment Strategy Experience Is Wealth Icon.png

strategies.name: Stars To Stars
strategies.effect: Upon merging a 3-star character, obtain 5 Gold Coin(s). Immediately obtain 1 "Staff Projector."
strategies.image: Investment Strategy Stars To Stars Icon.png

affixes.name: Follower Enhancement
affixes.effect: Normal and Elite enemies get enhanced, increasing their SPD by 30%, and Max HP by 20%.

affixes.name: Boss Enhancement
affixes.effect: Boss enemies get enhanced, increasing their SPD by 60%, and Max HP by 30%.

affixes.name: First Plane Enhancement
affixes.effect: Enemies in the First Plane get enhanced, increasing their SPD by 20%, and Max HP by 20%.

affixes.name: Second Plane Enhancement
affixes.effect: Enemies in the Second Plane get enhanced, increasing their SPD by 40%, and Max HP by 25%.

affixes.name: Third Plane Enhancement
affixes.effect: Enemies in the Third Plane get enhanced, increasing their SPD by 60%, and Max HP by 30%.

affixes.name: Corrosion: Follower Enhancement
affixes.effect: Normal and Elite enemies have a chance to be corroded by the Voracity. Normal and Elite enemies are enhanced, increasing their SPD by 24% and Max HP by 16%.

affixes.name: Corrosion: First Plane Enhancement
affixes.effect: Enemies in the First Plane have a chance to be corroded by the Voracity. Enemies in the First Plane are enhanced, increasing their SPD by 16% and Max HP by 16%.

affixes.name: Corrosion: Second Plane Enhancement
affixes.effect: Enemies in the Second Plane have a chance to be corroded by the Voracity. Enemies in the Second Plane are enhanced, increasing their SPD by 32% and Max HP by 20%.

affixes.name: Corrosion: Third Plane Enhancement
affixes.effect: Enemies in the Third Plane have a chance to be corroded by the Voracity. Enemies in the Third Plane are enhanced, increasing their SPD by 48% and Max HP by 24%.

affixes.name: Frontend Shutdown
affixes.effect: When entering combat, all DMG dealt by on-field characters at the start of battle is reduced to 1. This effect is dispelled after 1 attack(s).

affixes.name: Backend Shutdown
affixes.effect: When entering combat, all DMG dealt by off-field characters at the start of battle is reduced to 1. This effect is dispelled after 1 attack(s).

affixes.name: Magma Bombardment
affixes.effect: When entering combat, the first on-field ally character has a greatly increased chance of being attacked. After the enemy's attack, the target will be inflicted with Burn status, dealing Fire DoT equal to 12% of Max HP at the start of each turn for 3 turn(s). This burn effect is stackable.

affixes.name: Satisfying Brawl
affixes.effect: Combat Node countdown decreases by 30, but Boss Node countdown increases by 20.

affixes.name: Showdown Impending
affixes.effect: Boss Node countdown decreases by 30, but Encounter Node countdown increases by 20.

affixes.name: Extra Strike
affixes.effect: For each extra equipment slot missing on an ally member has when hit by an enemy attack, take an additional instance of True DMG equal to 8% of this attack's DMG.

affixes.name: Permanent Trauma
affixes.effect: When the ally squad's HP decreases, reduces their Max HP by 20% of the HP lost, up to 60% of their Max HP.

affixes.name: Heavy Footfall
affixes.effect: After an enemy attacks an ally, delays the attacked ally's action by 8%.

affixes.name: Carried by Inertia
affixes.effect: After enemy's first action, action advances by 100%.

affixes.name: Fight or Flight Response
affixes.effect: When enemies' HP percentage drops below 50%, their action advances by 100%.

affixes.name: Purity of Flesh and Mind
affixes.effect: When enemy HP percentage first falls below 50%, dispels all debuffs and restores 10% of their Max HP. For each debuff dispelled, restores an additional 2%.

affixes.name: Synchronized Action
affixes.effect: When the ally squad gains an effect that advances action, randomly causes an Elite/Boss enemy's action to advance by 20%.

affixes.name: Critical Conundrum
affixes.effect: When an on-field ally is attacked, decreases their healing and Shield strength by 50%, lasting for 1 turn(s).

affixes.name: Enervation
affixes.effect: Characters and their memosprites who are not wearing 3 pieces of equipment will deal 80% of their original DMG.

affixes.name: Cryogenic Hibernation
affixes.effect: When the ally squad receives a killing blow and is not knocked down, they will become Frozen for 2 turn(s).

affixes.name: Lost Luck
affixes.effect: Ally squad's Lucky Strike Rate decreases by 25%.

affixes.name: Prey on the Weak
affixes.effect: Damage dealt to 1-star ally members by enemies increases by 20%.

affixes.name: Blazing Vengeance
affixes.effect: When a non-boss enemy is eliminated, increases damage dealt by other enemies on the field by 8% for 1 turn(s). This effect is stackable.

affixes.name: Energy Disappearance
affixes.effect: After an enemy is attacked, reduces the attacker's Energy by 4 points. Energy will not be reduced if it is maxed.

affixes.name: Lead by Example
affixes.effect: The ally ranked first in the DMG output deals 75% of their original DMG, while other allies deal 110% of their original DMG.

affixes.name: Get Out of Jail Free Card
affixes.effect: When an enemy is under attack, if their HP percentage falls below 1%, their current HP will be set to 10% of their Max HP and won't drop below this value during the current attack. This effect can only trigger once per enemy.

affixes.name: Beyond Endurance
affixes.effect: After being attacked 7 times, enemies' action advances by 100%.

affixes.name: Self-Defense
affixes.effect: When an enemy is hit by an on-field target's attack, deal DMG equal to 120% of their ATK to the target who used the attack. This DMG cannot defeat the target.

affixes.name: Rapid Cooling
affixes.effect: At the end of an on-field ally's turn, for each Skill Point consumed this turn, there is a 15% fixed chance to become Frozen for 1 turn(s).

affixes.name: Emergency Hemostasis
affixes.effect: Enemy targets take DMG equal to 20% of their Max HP when entering combat and restore 15% of their Max HP after taking action for a total of 3 times.

affixes.name: Speed Alternation
affixes.effect: At the start of combat, the two ally characters with the highest SPD Amplification lose 40% SPD Amplification, and the two with lowest gain 25% SPD Amplification.

affixes.name: It's A Trap
affixes.effect: At the start of combat, on-field allies have a 40% base chance to enter the Imprisonment or Entanglement stat, delaying their action by 20% for 1 turn(s).

affixes.name: Treasure to Trash
affixes.effect: At the start of each plane, the first piece of advanced equipment synthesized has a 50% chance to become a Trash Bag.

affixes.name: Time Assassin
affixes.effect: During Combat Nodes, there's a chance to spawn Time Assassins whose attacks reduce the countdown by 7.

affixes.name: Curbed Physical
affixes.effect: When entering combat, all DMG dealt by Physical target in the ally squad is reduced by 1. This effect is dispelled after using 4 attack(s).

affixes.name: Curbed Fire
affixes.effect: When entering combat, all DMG dealt by Fire target in the ally squad is reduced by 1. This effect is dispelled after using 4 attack(s).

affixes.name: Curbed Ice
affixes.effect: When entering combat, all DMG dealt by Ice target in the ally squad is reduced by 1. This effect is dispelled after using 4 attack(s).

affixes.name: Curbed Lightning
affixes.effect: When entering combat, all DMG dealt by Lightning target in the ally squad is reduced by 1. This effect is dispelled after using 4 attack(s).

affixes.name: Curbed Wind
affixes.effect: When entering combat, all DMG dealt by Wind target in the ally squad is reduced by 1. This effect is dispelled after using 4 attack(s).

affixes.name: Curbed Quantum
affixes.effect: When entering combat, all DMG dealt by Quantum target in the ally squad is reduced by 1. This effect is dispelled after using 4 attack(s).

affixes.name: Curbed Imaginary
affixes.effect: When entering combat, all DMG dealt by Imaginary target in the ally squad is reduced by 1. This effect is dispelled after using 4 attack(s).

affixes.name: Bad Start
affixes.effect: Lose 20 Squad HP upon starting the run.

affixes.name: Connections First
affixes.effect: The ally squad deals 105% of the original DMG. The Base DMG from Bonds and Investment Strategies is adjusted to 70% of the original DMG.

affixes.name: Thick-Skinned
affixes.effect: When not Weakness Broken, enemy targets take 30% less DMG.

affixes.name: Blunt the Edge
affixes.effect: Allies with less than 20% DMG Mitigation deal only 80% of their original DMG.

affixes.name: Differential Treatment
affixes.effect: 1/2/3-star character in the ally squad deal 80%/90%/105% of their original DMG.

affixes.name: Rusting Treasury
affixes.effect: For each unequipped item in the preparation area's inventory, the DMG dealt by enemies increases by 3% and the DMG taken decreases by 4%, up to a maximum of 10 items taken into account.

affixes.name: Me, Alone
affixes.effect: When the character has 1/2/3 inactive Bonds, the DMG dealt becomes 85%/60%/30% of the original DMG.

affixes.name: Growing Pains
affixes.effect: After reaching level 8, with each Experience purchase, 1 Gold Coin(s) will be lost.

affixes.name: Cheap Taste
affixes.effect: DMG dealt by 3-cost and lower characters is changed to 105% of the original DMG, while DMG dealt by 4-cost characters or higher is changed to 80% of the original DMG.

affixes.name: Expensive Taste
affixes.effect: DMG dealt by 3-cost and lower characters is changed to 80% of the original DMG, while DMG dealt by 4-cost characters or higher is changed to 105% of the original DMG.
